question: What claim is made about the goddess's necessity for the continued existence of the entire world?
premises: The goddess is addressed as daughter of the mountain and sole mother of the world.
A counterfactual condition is posed regarding her absence.
The continued existence of the entire world is said not to be possible in that case.
inference: The goddess is asserted to be necessary for the very existence of the entire world.
plain_english: It is true, O daughter of the mountain, sole mother of the world: if not for you, the existence of the entire world would not be.
